children.name: Levenhookia aestiva Wege
children.description: Description. Annual herb 4 - 15 cm high. Glandular hairs somewhat viscid, 0.2 - 0.6 mm long. Stem dark red or brownish red, simple or branched to varying degrees with porrect or ascending lateral branches, glandular-hairy. Leaves cauline, scattered, green or red, glandular-hairy on the margins and abaxially, with a few hairs adaxially (mostly towards the base); lamina narrowly oblanceolate to oblanceolate, elliptic or ovate, 3 - 25 mm long including the petiole, 1 - 5.5 mm wide, acute to subacut
